policyNotes.currentBase: strict_required_status_checks_policy must stay enabled so a PR head contains the live master tip before merge.
policyNotes.reviewThreads: All review threads must be resolved before merge.
policyNotes.approval: Native approval count stays at 0 while the repository has one human owner: GitHub does not count an author's self-approval. Human authorization remains SHA/base-bound through review-window and merge:execute. Raise this value when an independent required reviewer exists.
policyNotes.mutation: This file and its checker are read-only. Apply live ruleset changes separately after merge.
